title: Polynomial product criterion
statement: Let $\ell$ be a positive integer, and let $m,a,b$ be binary vectors of length $\ell$. The coefficient equations saying that the product of the two low-degree polynomials associated with $a$ and $b$ has the coefficients specified by the monic polynomial associated with $m$ hold if and only if those two polynomials are equal.
